functionalRequirement: After adding a transportation route, the user shall be able to retrieve transportation requests from other users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support the retrieval of all transportation requests from other users after a new route is added, covering 100% of the specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to retrieve transportation requests, necessitating full coverage of this core functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that retrieved transportation requests match the criteria of the added route with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate retrieval of transportation requests based on the route added.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must retrieve transportation requests within 2 seconds for up to 1,000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time retrieval of requests, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory to process and retrieve transportation requests for a single user session.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple users and requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive user interface for adding routes and retrieving transportation requests, with consistent terminology and navigation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires interaction with the system, which should be easy to operate for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to retrieve transportation requests for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the transportation request system, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt transportation request data using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing user data, which is sensitive and requires protection.

functionalRequirement: The Disputes System shall allow users to create charge back requests, prompting for required information and resulting in printed notifications sent to merchants if proof of disputed transactions is not provided.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support the creation of charge back requests, prompting for all required information and sending printed notifications to merchants in 100% of applicable cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle charge back requests comprehensively, including all necessary steps.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that charge back requests are processed correctly, with 100% accuracy in prompting for required information and sending notifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct handling of charge back requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process a charge back request within 5 seconds for up to 500 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time processing of requests, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 50 MB of memory to process a single charge back request.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple requests.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear error messages and validation checks to prevent incorrect submission of charge back requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction, which should be protected against errors to ensure correct usage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to process charge back requests for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the disputes system, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that charge back requests and associated data are not altered during processing or transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive transaction data, which must be protected against unauthorized changes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for updates to the required information for charge back requests without affecting the core functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR may require changes over time, necessitating easy modification of the system.

functionalRequirement: For any systematic action, such as disputes aging process, a case activity will be generated, and the user who initiated the dispute case must be notified upon next logon.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate a case activity for every systematic action, such as disputes aging, and notify the initiating user upon their next logon in 100% of cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to generate activities and notifications for all systematic actions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that the generated case activities and notifications are accurate and relevant to the systematic action, with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct generation of activities and notifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate a case activity and prepare a notification within 1 second for up to 1,000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time generation of activities and notifications, requiring timely responses.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 20 MB of memory to generate a single case activity and notification.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for scalability, given the FR’s focus on handling multiple systematic actions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The system must provide clear and concise notifications to users upon logon, with an option to view detailed case activities.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires user interaction, which should be supported by clear and helpful notifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to generate case activities and notifications for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the system for generating activities and notifications, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt case activity and notification data using TLS 1.3 during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves accessing user data, which is sensitive and requires protection.

functionalRequirement: System shall read initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must read and process all initialization data to derive definitions of heating and cooling units for 100% of the specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to read and process initialization data comprehensively.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must derive accurate definitions of heating and cooling units from the initialization data with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise and correct derivation of unit definitions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must read and process initialization data within 10 seconds upon system startup.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves reading data at startup, requiring timely processing for system readiness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 10 MB of memory to read and process initialization data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for system performance, given the FR’s focus on initialization data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to read and process initialization data for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to initialization data, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that initialization data is not altered during reading and processing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical system data, which must be protected against unauthorized changes.
